`BUN_JSC_useSharedArrayBuffer` is `BUN_JSC_alwaysUseSharedArrayBuffer` since Bun 1.5. Bun doesn't start if the old name is set.

`--fix` renames it.

`bun lint --upgrade` runs this rule. See [Upgrade Bun](/lint#upgrade-bun).

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. To turn it on:

```toml bunfig.toml
[lint.rules]
"bun/no-renamed-env-vars" = "error" # or "warn"
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}
```ts
Bun.spawn(["bun", "worker.ts"], { env: { BUN_JSC_useSharedArrayBuffer: "0" } });
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}
```ts
Bun.spawn(["bun", "worker.ts"], { env: { BUN_JSC_alwaysUseSharedArrayBuffer: "0" } });
```
